name: Citadel Valley (crashed Gaerlan's Citadel)
title: Citadel Valley
summary: Citadel Valley is the deep, cliff-walled valley (floor z 60, walls to z 250-300) where Gaerlan's Citadel crashed after Gaerlan and Martine's battle, reachable only by quest portal. The kit shows the crashed citadel as a 5 x 5 grid of moss-grown halls and spired towers (z 75-93.5) heaped on shattered rock and crystal at the north end, and at the south end, at the foot of the cliff, a row of five Ziggurat portals (Lightning, Acid, Fire, Frost, Prismatic) - the portals to Asheron's golem ziggurats - with Asheron's Platinum Golem and Ornate Pillars about.
insertNote: Kept the batch's route position (chapter ch1).

shots.standingOrder: Spiral down 36 deg clockwise from 78 m to 45 m above the valley floor, radius 76 m to 58 m, east of the crashed citadel; keep 20 m from its towers and the valley wall, scrub may be faded.
shots.notes: Arrival in Citadel Valley, the cliff-walled pit where Gaerlan's Citadel crashed: a 5x5 grid of moss-grown halls and spired towers (tops 75-93.5 m) heaped on shattered rock, the unclimbable walls rising 200 m behind. The descent drops into the valley from the east with the noon sun high over the south wall. shots.standingOrder: Fly east 3 m above the valley floor at 4.5 m/s, 12 m north of the row of five ziggurat portals, yawing to keep the Fire Ziggurat centred; nothing within 10 m, the portals' swirls may never be faded.
shots.notes: Particle shot: the five elemental Ziggurat portals (Lightning, Acid, Fire, Frost, Prismatic) stand in a row at the foot of the south cliff; flying past on their north side puts the high noon sun behind them, so the five coloured swirls are backlit as they whip through the frame.
